method: All eight actual files inspected individually with view_image; exact generation or repair prompt read. Five equal-weight dimensions scored 0–100. No motion, audio, playability, model-rig or exact-dimension certification. Intentional bounded experimental spatial anomalies distinguished from accidental visible anatomy failures.

observations: The extra crossing staff is removed. One continuous diagonal shaft now runs from the hooked head through a coherent closed-hand grip to a short butt.
Original stone pavise, soaked cloth, salt-pitted metal, body stance and underwater scale remain intact.
defectsOrLimits: The image shows a poised guard state rather than the fully developed sweeping attack. This is acceptable encounter key art; do not claim an animation was verified.

observations: Four descending locomotor legs are now distinguishable: two dominant near-side supports and two separate far-side supports. Together with the two elevated blade limbs, the visible topology supports the six-limb identity.
Climbing contact, red joint membranes, olive chitin and sunlit forest remain convincing.
defectsOrLimits: Some far-side roots are partially occluded by the thorax, which is natural for this viewpoint. Orthographic rig-reference verification remains separate.

observations: Four arms are communicated through the upper bracing pair and lower shutter-carrying pair, with two large planted legs.

observations: Kneeling stance, buttress cover, shoulder brace, harness and heavy weapon communicate support and recoil preparation.
Older face, coarse coat, leather and worn metal sustain the adult material standard.
Fortress mirrors and long ramp maintain clear connection to the same region as the Sundered Engine.

observations: Matte empty ivory hood, grounded boots, long visible hands and plain staff provide an uncanny bodily presence without effect fog.
The ceiling shadow has a visibly different step or stance, giving the impossible geometry a specific narrative signal.
Ordinary mountain light through the doorway contrasts legibly with the chamber-local anomaly.
defectsOrLimits: The basic hooded-traveler silhouette is familiar across fantasy; the specific ceiling-shadow relation and empty folded cloth must remain its distinguishing identity.
Spatial and shadow impossibility is intentional and explicitly experimental. It is not treated as accidental anatomy failure or as approved cosmology.

observations: Interlocking pale arches, empty center and jointed support structures establish a distinctly nonhumanoid architectural creature.
Falling dust, hinge contact and the stair route passing into the moving structure communicate the encounter problem.
Dark room, pale stone body and ordinary landscape beyond create strong separation with restrained supernatural accents.
defectsOrLimits: Only three major support feet are fully apparent; the fourth can be occluded by the central stair and architecture. Do not claim an exact four-foot orthographic verification.
The moving geometry is an intentional bounded experimental premise. Key art does not demonstrate a mechanically solvable route or an implemented hinge system.

observations: Small eyes, narrow muzzle, massive adult shoulder structure and forceful paw contact clearly avoid juvenile bear proportions.
Broken ice, displaced water, coarse wet fur and mountaineer cover make the creature physically dangerous.
Cold glacier depth with sparse warm lamps creates luminous winter fantasy rather than a mascot setting.
defectsOrLimits: The species read is deliberately a giant polar ursid; its distinguishing cues are elongated forequarters, old restraint evidence and ice-breaking behavior rather than a radically novel body plan.
The shoulder restraint mark looks partly like a surviving band or embedded remnant. Record its exact status in the model reference instead of silently changing a scar into equipment.
